description: gilyon/snes-tests spctest (S-SMP SPC700 opcode test, 1368 tests) at tag v1.4, patched on the S-CPU side only to report over the VELOCE-RESULT/1 $21FE port (SNES-3). The S-SMP programs are built unmodified. make_tests.py also writes spc_expected.inc, a per-test table of expected P/A/X/Y and the test name, in the unused LoROM bank 3. The S-CPU reads gilyon's port protocol: a program that reports success at test L passed every test up to L (one CHECK PASS each); a failure at test N gives CHECK N FAIL with the first mismatching P/A/X/Y byte as exp/got plus a REG line, then END. A test number that stops changing for 120 frames is reported as a hung S-SMP (CHECK FAIL + END).

golden_gate_reason: spctest.sfc, spc_tests*.asm, *.spc and tests.txt are gitignored upstream (spctest/.gitignore); v1.4 ships no binary. The spctest.sfc in the higan/snes-test-roms mirror is an older 1320-test build (before v1.4's 'Add missing or tests' commit), so it is not a byte reference for this source either. Verified behaviourally -- see PROVENANCE.md.
